_original_lore: Cows are an animal in Hypixel Skyblock. Cows can
be found at the Barn and are required to unlock
the Leather Collection. Cows can also be spawned
with the use of a Cow Minion.
name: 牛 (动物)

source: Cows are an animal in Hypixel Skyblock. Cows can
be found at the Barn and are required to unlock
the Leather Collection. Cows can also be spawned
with the use of a Cow Minion.
loreParagraphs.translation: 牛是海像素空岛生存中的一种动物.牛可以在农庄找到,是解锁皮革收藏所必需的.牛也可以使用牛仆从生成.
